build_Kinetics_dataset: build a Kinetics dataset loader for train, val, or test mode with config and num_retries
construct_Kinetics_loader: construct the Kinetics video loader by reading CSV files with video paths and labels
test_Kinetics_getitem: test the Kinetics dataset getitem method to sample and decode video frames with retries
review_Kinetics_aug_frame: review the Kinetics _aug_frame method for data augmentation with random erasing and spatial sampling
summarize_Kinetics_class: summarize the Kinetics PyTorch Dataset class for video clip sampling and frame decoding
